critical_rule: THE BACKGROUND MUST COME FROM IMAGE 2 ONLY. Image 2 and image 3 show DIFFERENT rooms. Image 3 is a finished slide that already carries a photo background, and that photo is the WRONG room. It must never appear in the output. Image 3 is supplied for its printed words only.

image_input_order.image_1: FACT_LAYOUT_TEMPLATE. The layout to keep: check mark emoji, bold white FACT: headline, thin white underline, and all spacing, alignment, and typography. Its black area is a placeholder to be filled by image 2. [Auto Generated] is the only text that may change.
image_input_order.image_2: BACKGROUND_SOURCE. The blended Interior3 + Furniture Item photo. This is the ONLY source of the output background. Every pixel of the finished background comes from here.
image_input_order.image_3: TEXT_ONLY_DO_NOT_COPY. The finished Myth slide. Treat it as a written note, not a picture. Read ONLY the myth sentence printed on it. Its room, product, background photo, red cross emoji, and MYTH: headline are all forbidden in the output.

background_rules.replace: Fill the black area of image 1 completely with image 2, edge to edge, no black borders or empty areas. Crop, scale, or reposition image 2 only as needed, keeping its main product and key interior details visible.
background_rules.preserve_source: Keep image 2 accurate: same product, architecture, lighting, colors, materials, textures, shadows, perspective, scale, atmosphere.
background_rules.forbidden_source: Never take the background, room, furniture, or any pixel from image 3. If the room shown in the output matches image 3 instead of image 2, the result is wrong.
background_rules.restriction: Do not redesign the room, replace or alter the product, invent major objects, or build a different scene.

fact_text_generation.instruction: Read the myth sentence printed on image 3, then replace the [Auto Generated] wording with exactly one concise fact that debunks that specific myth.
fact_text_generation.debunk_requirement: Correct the exact claim on image 3, not a different or generic topic, and state what is actually true rather than only that the myth is false.
fact_text_generation.product_awareness: Ground the correction in the lighting or furniture product visible in image 2 so the fact matches the photo on screen.
fact_text_generation.accuracy: Use only the myth text on image 3 and elements clearly visible in image 2. Never invent furniture, materials, dimensions, or specifications.
fact_text_generation.originality: Fresh fact every run. Do not copy the placeholder, the myth wording, or wording from this JSON.
fact_text_generation.length: One to two sentences maximum, short enough to sit in the existing text area without changing the typography scale.
fact_text_generation.restriction: Professional English, authoritative and corrective. Do not restate the myth on the slide. No hashtags, headings, captions, calls to action, or multiple facts.

layout_rules.emoji: The check mark emoji is permanent: same upper-left position, appearance, size, color. Never swap it for the red cross emoji from image 3.
layout_rules.headline: The bold white FACT: headline is permanent: same position right of the emoji, same typography, size, weight, alignment. Never output MYTH:.
layout_rules.underline: Keep the thin white horizontal line below FACT: exactly as shown.
layout_rules.text_style: Place the fact exactly where [Auto Generated] sits, below the underline, in the template's clean white modern sans-serif type. Wrap naturally to fit the text area, fully inside the canvas, never clipped.

readability_rules: All typography must stay clearly readable over the background. Prefer cropping and positioning image 2 so text sits over a suitable area; only if needed add subtle darkening or a soft shadow behind the text. No opaque black rectangle or heavy overlay.

strict_rules.change_only: Only the black background and the [Auto Generated] text may change. Never remove, reword, recolor, resize, or reposition the emoji, headline, or underline.
strict_rules.preserve_product: Do not alter the identity, shape, structure, materials, color, or proportions of the product in image 2.
strict_rules.no_extras: No logos, extra emojis, icons, borders, watermarks, or unrelated graphics.

final_check: Before returning the image, verify all four: (1) the room, product, and camera angle in the background match IMAGE 2, not image 3; (2) the icon is the check mark, not a red cross; (3) the headline reads FACT:; (4) the body text is a fact answering the myth printed on image 3. If check 1 fails, redo the background using image 2.

output.result: Image 2 fills the background, the Fact layout stays intact, and one newly generated fact debunks the myth shown on image 3.
